title: THC Advanced Propagation and Tissue Culture Certificate
publicDesignation: THC Advanced Propagation and Tissue Culture Certificate

assessmentModel.knowledgeAssessment: Randomized advanced propagation and tissue-culture assessment mapped to six course objectives; credential use remains blocked until bank depth, review, pilot evidence and standard-setting are complete.
assessmentModel.retakePolicy: Maximum attempts and cooldown must follow the current approved course assessment configuration once validation is complete.
assessmentModel.completionEvidence: Course completion and final-assessment result must be retained in the Academy learner record.
assessmentModel.performanceEvidence: The required propagation and tissue-culture QA practical must be passed with no critical errors and verified evidence artifacts.

limitations: Does not authorize unsafe biological handling, unsupported pathogen or genetic diagnosis, or process changes outside assigned workplace authority.
Does not replace laboratory confirmation, employer procedures, biosafety requirements or jurisdiction-specific rules where applicable.
Documents Academy educational/workforce achievement and is not an independent personnel certification or government license.
